title: 🐛 fix(config): let TOML env refs take path, set and env list values

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+A TOML ``{ replace = "ref", env = ..., key = ... }`` now takes a path (``change_dir``, ``env_dir``), set (``extras``,
+``labels``, ``dependency_groups``) or environment list (``depends``) value from another environment, instead of failing
+validation of the referencing key.

+    @staticmethod
+    def _to_raw(value: object) -> TomlTypes:
+        if isinstance(value, (PythonDeps, PythonConstraints)):
+            value = value.lines()
+        elif isinstance(value, Command):
+            value = value.raw_args
+        elif isinstance(value, list) and all(isinstance(entry, Command) for entry in value):
+            value = [entry.raw_args for entry in value]
+        elif isinstance(value, Path):
+            value = str(value)
+        elif isinstance(value, EnvList):
+            value = list(value.envs)
+        elif isinstance(value, set):  # sort it like stringify does, so the order is stable
+            value = sorted(value)
+        return cast("TomlTypes", value)
+

+def test_config_in_toml_replace_ref_path(tox_project: ToxProjectCreator) -> None:
+    project: Final[ToxProject] = tox_project({
+        "pyproject.toml": dedent("""
+        [tool.tox.env.a]
+        package = "skip"
+        change_dir = "sub"
+
+        [tool.tox.env.b]
+        package = "skip"
+        change_dir = { replace = "ref", env = "a", key = "change_dir" }
+        """),
+    })
+    outcome: Final[ToxRunOutcome] = project.run("c", "-e", "b", "-k", "change_dir")
+    outcome.assert_success()
+    assert outcome.env_conf("b")["change_dir"] == project.path / "sub"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("key", "expected"),
+    [
+        pytest.param("extras", {"x", "y"}, id="extras"),
+        pytest.param("labels", {"lint"}, id="labels"),
+        pytest.param("depends", EnvList(["c"]), id="depends"),
+        pytest.param("description", "demo", id="description"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_config_in_toml_replace_ref_value(
+    tox_project: ToxProjectCreator, key: str, expected: set[str] | EnvList | str
+) -> None:
+    outcome: Final[ToxRunOutcome] = tox_project({
+        "pyproject.toml": dedent(f"""
+        [tool.tox.env.a]
+        package = "skip"
+        extras = ["y", "x"]
+        labels = ["lint"]
+        depends = ["c"]
+        description = "demo"
+
+        [tool.tox.env.b]
+        package = "skip"
+        {key} = {{ replace = "ref", env = "a", key = "{key}" }}
+
+        [tool.tox.env.c]
+        package = "skip"
+        """),
+    }).run("c", "-e", "b", "-k", key)
+    outcome.assert_success()
+    assert outcome.env_conf("b")[key] == expected
+
+
